cdade65c: If the user does not enter any value, go to the next field if the field is not required (DV does not contain 'R'), exit if it is not LAYGO or the data value is not greater than 0 (no records to edit), or go to the UPDATE^DIE entry point for that field.
ef670632: If the user enters a question mark, go to the extended reader help.
b45e977d: If the user enters an at sign, go to the exit processing for the current field.

a2e6a320: If the user enters a space, and the data value (DV) contains 'd' (suggesting a date field), and the data value does not contain 'P' (indicating a multiple field), and the user's device subfile contains an entry for this field label (DLB), retrieve the previously entered value for this field and display it.

6effde01: If the data value (DV) contains 'V' (indicating a set of codes), 'M' (indicating a multiple field), or if there is MUMPS code in the MUMPS CROSS REFERENCE field (#12.1) of the DD for this field, execute the appropriate code to process the user's input.

8b51645a: If the user's input matches one of the entries in the set of codes (DU), execute any MUMPS code specified in the INPUT TRANSFORM field of the DD for this field. If the input is valid, quit the loop. Otherwise, continue to the next entry in the set of codes.

fbb3167a: If the user's input did not match any of the entries in the set of codes, display the remainder of the current entry (after the ':' separator) and set the internal value of X to the portion before the ':'.

4d3a3fd3: If the data value (DV) contains 'P' (indicating a pointer to another file), set up the DIC array for the Finder and execute it. If the user selects an entry, set X to the internal entry number of the selected entry. If the user does not select an entry (X<0), go to the exit processing for the current field.

50d44107: If the data value does not contain 'N' (indicating a numeric type), execute the INPUT TRANSFORM for the field. If the user's input has more than 24 decimal places, discard the input and go to the exit processing for the field.

da5551e6: If the data value specifies a maximum number of decimal places, remove any leading or trailing zeros from the decimal portion of the user's input. If the user's input has no decimal portion but includes a decimal point, treat it as an integer.
4d8574ca: Execute any MUMPS code specified in the MUMPS CROSS REFERENCE field (#12.1) of the DD for this field. Clear the YS variable.

2dc7bc8f: Clear the DIC('S') and DLAYGO variables used by the Finder. If the user entered a value for this field, save it in the DG array and, if the data value contains 'd', save it in the user's device subfile. Go to the next field.
c2ac13e5: Display a '??' prompt and go to the EXIT processing if the DD contains any code for that entry point.
e11cb44a: Set the internal value of X to '?BAD' to indicate an invalid user input.
1d01d88b: If the user enters a question mark followed by additional text, execute the DEVELOPER GOES HERE code for an extended reader, and then go to the BRANCHING CODE section.
